beats.text: Zhuangzi fell asleep one afternoon and dreamed he was a butterfly.
Not a man dreaming of a butterfly — but a butterfly, drifting, knowing nothing of any Zhuangzi.
Then he woke, solid and human again, lying in the grass.
But a question stayed with him, and he could not shake it loose.
Was he a man who had dreamed he was a butterfly — or a butterfly now dreaming it is a man?
From inside the dream, it felt completely real. So how certain are you about this moment?
Zhuangzi wasn't trying to scare you. He was loosening your grip on being so sure what you are.

source_note: From the Zhuangzi, trans. James Legge (public domain).
